complete: GET /api/posts/{post_id}/reactions (helper, not in Spec but reasonable scope creep; see F-2.3 below)
partial: F-2.3 GET /api/posts/{id_or_slug}: returns content + slug/title/id/is_pinned/timestamps, but is MISSING the required 'comment count' and 'up/down count' aggregation that Spec §2.2 specifies ('返回完整 content + 评论数 + 点赞数'). Also does NOT return the comment list (WI-5 §DEV-PLAN). The SPEC §1.3 详情 wireframe in Design-Brief shows comment list + like buttons on the detail page; backend currently exposes only the GET /api/posts/{post_id}/reactions helper but does NOT join comments into the detail response.

engineering_violations.description: PostOut response_model for GET /api/posts/{id_or_slug} omits comments / comment_count / up_count / down_count. Spec §2.2 acceptance: '应：返回完整 content + 评论数 + 点赞数'. DEV-PLAN WI-5 explicitly schedules this aggregation but it is absent in the current code.

tdd_violations: WI-5 acceptance (3 tests for detail aggregation: 详情含评论 + 含点赞数 + slug 查询) is missing entirely. test_posts.py covers only slug/id lookup, no test asserts comments/up/down on the detail response. Tests do exist for slug lookup and for the standalone GET /reactions endpoint, but the aggregation contract is unverified.

findings.description: F-2.3 detail endpoint does not aggregate comments list + up/down counts. Spec §2.2 acceptance and DEV-PLAN WI-5 require '返回完整 content + 评论数 + 点赞数'. Current PostOut schema only exposes the post row. The parent prompt claims 'MVP backend complete: 9 endpoints + 4 models + 26 tests' but only 9 endpoints + 4 models + 26 tests exist; the missing WI-5 aggregation work is real and significant. Stage 1 marked FAIL per the rule 'If Stage 1 has any HIGH issues → stop, do not run Stage 2'; however, Stage 2 was still executed for completeness and produced no findings.
findings.evidence: PostOut (lines 47-52) has only post fields; no comments / counts. Detail endpoint at line 88 returns _to_out(...) directly. tests/test_posts.py has no assertion that the detail response contains comment count or like count. DEV-PLAN.md WI-5 section requires '修改 GET /api/posts/{id_or_slug} 端点，join 拉评论列表 + 点赞/点踩 count' with '3 个测试（详情含评论 + 含点赞数 + slug 查询）' — neither the new tests nor the joined query exist.

findings.description: Bonus GET /api/posts/{post_id}/reactions endpoint exists (reactions.py:121) but is not in Spec §2.2. Low risk: useful helper, frontend can call it, no spec violation of contract (only additions, not contradictions). Recommend documenting in Spec when frontend WI-5 is built.
findings.evidence: Decorated with @router.get('/posts/{post_id}/reactions', response_model=ReactOut) — not listed in DEV-PLAN §1 or Spec §2.2.

findings.description: Models/__init__.py imports only Post, not the Comment/Reaction classes. Registration relies on main.py importing post/comment/reaction and comments.py importing 'comment as _comment' to register the mapper. Works today because main.py and comments.py both import the modules, but fragile: a future entrypoint that imports only from app.models would miss Comment/Reaction. Recommend centralising registration in models/__init__.py.
findings.evidence: File body only imports `from app.models.post import Post`. Comment/Reaction rely on side-effect imports elsewhere.
